d: One dangerous animal is all it takes to turn an ordinary day into a rescue operation! In this compilation, Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, takes on a series of challenging wildlife calls where unwanted creatures threaten homes, businesses, farms and livestock. From wild hogs and troublesome muskrats to a coyote on the loose and a feral horse spooking cattle, every encounter brings a different challenge. And when a mother raccoon is caught during a call, rescuing her babies becomes an urgent animal rescue mission.
